title: Hour one or hour twelve?
hook: Does a whole-shift average hide a decline in hand-hygiene compliance?

knows: basic arithmetic and reading a small table
doesNotKnow: Read changes across the shift without inferring that time alone caused the difference.

misconception: The quantities in this case can be combined without checking their reference, denominator, or information boundary.
objective: Read changes across the shift without inferring that time alone caused the difference.
keyState: Both complete computed cases are visible as retained observations; the question-case picture survives Reset.

claims.text: Toy compliance is 90% at shift start and 81.3% at the end. What is the end-minus-start change? Toy inputs A=[90, 81.3]; B=[90, 90].
claims.source: Local explicit hypothetical assumptions in spec.ts and model.ts; not participant measurements.

claims.text: Computed results: [[-8.700000000000003, 90, 81.3], [0, 90, 90]]. Labels: End−start pp, Start %, End %.
claims.source: compute() in the lesson-local model.ts; finite numeric operations over the explicit inputs.

claims.text: The within-shift comparison measures a change, while the stable case measures none. Time, workload, case mix and other factors may move together. The numerical change alone cannot identify fatigue as its sole cause.
claims.source: The two controlled cases in spec.ts; scope limited to these toy inputs and displayed model rule.

claims.text: A new toy case uses Start compliance %=90, End compliance %=90. What is End−start pp? Answer: 0.
claims.source: compute() applied to the contrasting new input case; source list is an idea pointer only.

recall.question: A new toy case uses Start compliance %=90, End compliance %=90. What is End−start pp?
recall.why: Applying the stated toy rule to the new inputs gives 0. The result depends on these assumptions; it is not a universal behavioral response.

sourceProvenance.text: Hospital caregivers' hand-hygiene compliance fell 8.7 percentage points over a 12-hour shift (Dai, Milkman, Hofmann & Staats, 2015).
sourceProvenance.caveat: Original list says figures are approximate and papers were not individually rechecked. No empirical source is verified by this build.

meaningfulDifference: Read changes across the shift without inferring that time alone caused the difference.
